payload.request_verbatim: Design a flanged bushing with a sliding-fit bore for a 20 mm shaft and a 4-hole M4 bolt circle on the flange.

deliverables.name: flanged-bushing
deliverables.title: Flanged bushing
deliverables.description: Single flanged bushing: cylindrical body with through bore for a 20 mm shaft (sliding fit) and a radial flange carrying a 4-hole M4 bolt circle.

acceptance_criteria.text: Through bore is a sliding (clearance) fit for a 20 mm shaft

check.pass_rule: bore ID is clearance fit to 20 mm shaft per chosen sliding-fit class (e.g. ISO H7: 20.000–20.021 mm)

acceptance_criteria.text: Flange has exactly four holes for M4 bolts, equally spaced on a bolt circle

check.pass_rule: hole_count == 4; angular spacing 90° ±1°; hole diameter suitable for M4 clearance (~4.3–4.8 mm) unless stated otherwise

acceptance_criteria.text: Geometry is a flanged bushing: cylindrical hub/body plus larger-diameter radial flange at one end, coaxial through bore

check.pass_rule: named outline shows coaxial bore, cylindrical body, and distinct flange with bolt holes

assumptions.text: Only a 3D part model is in scope; no drawing, CAM program, or analysis report
assumptions.basis: request says 'Design a flanged bushing' with no mention of drawing/G-code/report

assumptions.text: Sliding fit means ISO clearance bore H7 on nominal 20 mm (for a 20 mm shaft)
assumptions.basis: user said 'sliding-fit bore'; H7 is the common sliding/locational clearance bore class at this size

assumptions.text: Material unspecified; downstream may use project default or a typical bushing material (e.g. bronze/brass or 6061 prototype)
assumptions.basis: no material in request; empty project has no material default set

assumptions.text: Unstated envelope (hub OD, length, flange OD/thickness, bolt-circle PCD) chosen from typical flanged-bushing proportions for a 20 mm bore and M4 flange fasteners
assumptions.basis: request specifies functional features only; no overall sizes or PCD given

assumptions.text: M4 flange holes are clearance through-holes (not tapped) on the bolt circle
assumptions.basis: phrase 'M4 bolt circle' implies through-bolts into a mating part or nuts

readings: use typical PCD for 20 mm-bore flanged bushing with M4

ambiguities.text: Exact sliding-fit tolerance class not named

payload.notes: Single-part mission. Empty project (no open docs). part_search for flanged bushing 20mm returned 0 hits / live timeouts — custom part, not library.
